title: Change the magnetic flux faster
hook: Change flux-change rate magnitude and predict induced emf magnitude.
misconception: induced emf magnitude stays fixed when flux-change rate magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt) to compare induced emf magnitude when flux-change rate magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed-turn coil with the same flux change through each turn, emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt). When flux-change rate magnitude doubles, induced emf magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed-turn coil with the same flux change through each turn, with a nonzero initial result. If flux-change rate magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on induced emf magnitude?
recall.why: Apply emf magnitude = N abs(dΦ/dt) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
